environment.description: Same application deployed on a hardened GKE Autopilot cluster. The pod spec includes a custom seccomp profile loaded via the node's /var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/profiles/workflow-engine.json which is enforced through a securityContext annotation (seccompProfile type: Localhost, localhostProfile: profiles/workflow-engine.json). The profile uses SCMP_ACT_ERRNO as defaultAction with an explicit allowlist of 78 syscalls required for .NET CLR operation (read, write, open, close, mmap, mprotect, brk, futex, clone3 for threadpool, etc.) but specifically OMITS execve (59), execveat (322), ptrace (101), socket (41), connect (42), bind (49), and listen (50) from the allowlist. Additionally, the GKE node pool uses gVisor (runsc) as the container sandbox runtime which provides a secondary syscall filtering layer. The combination means even if deserialization triggers Process.Start or similar, the underlying execve syscall returns EPERM.
